name: Scout24 SE
summary: Scout24 SE operates ImmoScout24, a digital marketplace for the residential and commercial real estate sectors in Germany and internationally. The company operates through Professional and Private segments. It offers Pay-per-ad, for listing real estate without membership; Realtor Lead Engine (RLE) for selling real estate; Mortgage Lead Engine; CRM software solutions for real estate agents; and ESG energy performance certificates.
